name: quiver
description: One arrow, one skill. A growing quiver of skills for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, pi, PrimeAgent) — brainstorm for design alignment, handover for multilingual session notes, catchup for reading them back, relay for igniting a background agent from the latest note.

plugins.name: quiver
plugins.description: Design-first brainstorming (divergent options + convergent grilling), multilingual session handovers (en/ja/zh with language memory), read-only catch-up briefs over the latest notes plus the git delta since them, and relay: hand the latest note to a fresh unattended background agent. Skills: /quiver:brainstorm, /quiver:handover, /quiver:catchup, /quiver:relay.
